title: Blind SSTI out-of-band callback — Velocity (java)
remediation: Do not pass user input into a template as template source. Use the engine's sandboxed/auto-escaping context and pass user data ONLY as rendered variables, never concatenated into the template string; disable dangerous builtins/reflection. The inbound callback proves the target executed the tokened callback URL (a token-matched, receipt-verified out-of-band interaction occurred); that a server-side template evaluation was the cause is the operator's LEAD, confirmed separately — the out-of-band execution is the proven fact.
